concurrency_comment: Pin to 1. At default concurrency, Postgres container contention across parallel runners produces timeouts, and Stryker SCORES A TIMEOUT AS A KILL — a measured run reported 17 killed / 13 timeout, and every one of those 13 became a genuine assertion-kill at concurrency 1. A parallel run here measures Docker, not your tests.
timeoutMS_comment: Container startup happens inside the measured window, so the default 5000ms puts legitimate runs near the timeout — which would inflate the score for the reason above.
ignorePatterns_comment: Generated artifacts are not inputs to mutation testing, and copying them into the sandbox races with any concurrent Playwright or reporter run.
